title: Developer Experience Playbook Pilot - Checklist & Brown-bag Notes
content:
Meeting: DevEx Playbook Pilot — Brown-bag + Checklist walkthrough
Date: 2026-02-25 (notes curated & annotated 2026-03-10)
Attendees: Evan Park (owner), Priya Desai, Aisha Khan, Carlos Mendez, Samir Patel, + several drop-ins (eng, docs)

Purpose:
- Align on a minimal, repeatable playbook for new internal teams to get from 0 -> prod with Redwood: quickstart sample, SDK recipe, test prompts, and rollout checklist.
- Surface blockers that will break the pilot if not addressed before 3/12 pilot start.

Agenda (20m):
- Quick walkthrough of playbook draft (3 sections: Quickstart app, SDK integration, Observability + Rollout checklist)
- Demo: toy sample (Next.js) that uses hosted API with streaming and fallback model routing
- Identify missing docs, sample gaps, and required infra config for Dedicated/Private flows
- Assign owners + ship date targets

Decisions made:
- Single canonical quickstart: Next.js + serverless API route that demonstrates streaming + function calling. This reduces cognitive load for product demos. (owner: Priya)
- Samples folder will contain: 1) minimal quickstart, 2) conversation sample showing function calls, 3) embeddings example for similarity search. Keep each < 200 LOC. (owner: Carlos)
- Observability checklist will use Console screenshots + prose steps (not full dashboard templates) for the pilot, to keep scope small. (owner: Aisha)

Notes / Raw capture (choppy - working doc):
- Quickstart gaps: auth snippet is inconsistent between SDK variants (py/js). TODO unify token/credentials example.
- Need small script that populates a demo dataset for the embeddings sample. Samir volunteered to sketch generator.
- SDK PR (#482) includes improved streaming API; verify backwards compat. If breaking, mark as alpha in quickstart.
- Private deploy notes: include a short section on env/network pre-reqs (VPC routes, KMS setup). Do not include full ops runbook — link to Private repo.
- Rollout checklist: smoke test, latency SLO verification, fallback policy configured, canary traffic config, cost guardrail check. We agreed cost guardrail = token budget threshold + automatic fallback to cheaper model.
- UX: interactive code sandbox (repl.it / stackblitz) would be fantastic for onboarding but out of scope for MVP. Keep as backlog item.

Open questions / risks:
- Risk: streaming semantics differ across SDK languages (gap could confuse users). Q: do we document the nuance or make SDKs align before pilot? Action: capture minimal note in quickstart and file ticket. (ticket: DX-317)
- Risk: sample dataset size — larger datasets make embeddings example slow and inflate CI cost. Decision: include a small synthetic generator and a precomputed minibundle (100 vectors).
- Access: internal testers may not have Dedicated credentials. Need to provide stubbed config that points to hosted API with test keys. (owner: Evan)

Action items (owners & rough ETA):
- Priya: Author the canonical Next.js quickstart (server + client pattern, streaming example) — draft by 2026-03-05.
- Carlos: Create three slim samples (quickstart, function-calls chat, embeddings) and add README with expected runtime & cost notes — 2026-03-08.
- Aisha: Draft Observability checklist + two Console screenshots for latency and token cost breakdown — 2026-03-07.
- Samir: Embeddings synthetic data generator + precomputed 100-vector bundle; upload to samples/assets — 2026-03-04.
- Evan: Prepare internal test creds and deployment stub that points to hosted mode for pilot testers; also write short note on Dedicated/Private caveats — 2026-03-03.
- All: Review SDK PR #482 for compatibility with quickstart; leave comments or approval — by 2026-03-02.

Follow-ups (next meeting / sync):
- Quick demo boarding call with two internal pilot customers (solutions engineering) — schedule 2026-03-10.
- Dry-run of onboarding script with 3 engineers (verify friction points) — 2026-03-11.

Notes to self (Evan):
- Keep markdown examples tiny; avoid >1 file per sample. People skip multi-file examples.
- We must call out cost estimate next to every sample (rough token count per typical run).
- Capture two explicit rollback examples in rollout checklist: model fallback + region failover.

Loose ends / backlog (post-pilot):
- Interactive sandboxes + one-click deploy templates for VPC/Dedicated.
- Longer-form tutorial: embedding retrieval at scale (pagination, storage connectors).
- Internationalization notes for sample text (i18n) — low priority.

Appendix: useful links & refs
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/482
- Pilot tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DX-317
- Playbook draft (internal wiki): https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DEVEXP/pages/23456/Playbook+Pilot

End notes: This doc is working draft; please add comments inline or DM for urgent blockers. Intend to freeze core artifacts for pilot 2026-03-12 (soft freeze).

-- Evan
